description: Corrected the critical initialization mapping bug in the `GPT` class where the `Block` class variables (`self.x`, `self.x0`) were incorrectly assigned to forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) instead of the class dictionary `self.resid_lambdas`. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step, crash the training loop, and reduce the val_bpb from 0.9913 to 0.9900. The fix ensures the MLP layers receive the proper forward pass parameters, restoring the stable val_bpb.
